lines.en: striking ?
lines.zh: 我们教区的牧师总是为各种各样的事筹集资金。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 但始终未能筹足资金把教堂的钟修好。

lines.en: Our vicar is always raising money for one cause or another, but he has never managed to get enough money to have the church clock repaired.
lines.zh: 教堂的钟很大，以前不分昼夜打点报时，但很多年前遭到毁坏，从此便无声无息了。

lines.en: The big clock which used to strike the hours day and night was damaged many years ago and has been silent ever since.
lines.zh: 一天夜里，我们的牧师突然被惊醒了，大钟又在“打点”报时了！

lines.en: One night, however, our vicar woke up with a start: the clock was striking the hours!
lines.zh: 他一看表，才1点钟，可是那钟一边敲了13下才停。

lines.en: Looking at his watch, he saw that it was one o'clock, but the bell struck thirteen times before it stopped.
lines.zh: 牧师拿着一支电筒走上钟楼想去看看究竟发生了什么事情。

lines.en: Armed with a torch, the vicar went up into the clock tower to see what was going on.
lines.zh: 借着电筒光。

lines.en: In the torchlight, he caught sight of a figure whom he immediately recognized as Bill Wilkins, our local grocer 'Whatever are you doing up here Bill?
lines.zh: 他看见一个人，马上认出那是本地杂货店主比尔。威尔金斯。

lines.en: asked the vicar in surprise.
lines.zh: “你究竟在这上面干什么，比尔？

lines.en: 'I'm trying to repair the bell,' answered Bill.
lines.zh: ”牧师惊讶地问。

lines.en: 'I've been coming up here night after night for weeks now.
lines.zh: “我想把这口钟修好，”比尔回答说。

lines.en: You see, I was hoping to give you a surprise.
lines.zh: “好几个星期了，我天天夜里到钟楼上来。

lines.en: 'You certainly did give me a surprise!
lines.zh: 嗯，我是想让你大吃一惊。

lines.en: said the vicar.
lines.zh: ”“你确实使我大吃了一惊！

lines.en: 'You've probably woken up everyone in the village as well.
lines.zh: ”牧师说，“也许同时你把村里所有的人都吵醒了。

lines.en: Still, I'm glad the bell is working again.
lines.zh: 不过，钟又能报时了，我还是很高兴的。

lines.en: That's the trouble, vicar,' answered Bill.
lines.zh: ”“问题就在这里，牧师，”比尔回答说。

lines.en: 'It's working all right, but I'm afraid that at one o'clock it will strike thirteen times and there's nothing I can do about it.
lines.zh: “不错，钟能报时了，但是，恐怕每到1点钟，它总要敲13下，对此我已无能为力了。

lines.en: We'll get used to that, Bill,' said the vicar.
lines.zh: ”“大家慢慢就习惯了，比尔，”牧师说。

lines.en: "Thirteen is not as good as one, but it's better than nothing.
lines.zh: “13下是不如1下好，但总比1下也不敲强。

lines.en: Now let's go downstairs and have a cup of tea.'
lines.zh: 来，咱们下楼去喝杯茶吧。”
